title: CCPA order dated 10 Nov 2026 (Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare, Commissioner Anupam Mishra; case CCPA-2/55/2025-CCPA) fines ANI Technologies (Ola) ₹10 lakh over pre-acceptance add-on/tip prompts such as 'Improve your chances of quicker ride confirmation!'; held a misleading advertisement and a dark pattern; prompts to stop forthwith on every Ola platform, compliance report within 15 days; Ola's own data showed add-on requests were accepted less often (no figures used: order and Bar & Bench disagree); suggested amounts started at ₹10–₹40 and were later raised; Ola argued add-on optional, all to driver, used for less viable rides; Rapido fined ₹10 lakh in Sept 2026; National Consumer Helpline 1915 / 1800-11-4000

sources.outlet: Central Consumer Protection Authority (order, published by Bar & Bench)
National Consumer Helpline (Department of Consumer Affairs)

CCPA fined ANI Technologies (Ola) ₹10 la: https://images.assettype.com/barandbench/2026-11-11/t4ajnxqx/Ola_CCPA_order.pdf (p.1 'Date: 10.11.2026'; para 89(iii) 'directed to pay a penalty of ₹10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh only)')

https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/olas-extra-pay-for-faster-rides-feature-doesnt-work-ccpa-asks-it-to-scrap-practice-slaps-10-lakh-penalty ('fined ANI Technologies Private Limited, which operates Ola, ₹10 lakh … order dated November 10')
Prompts asked riders to pay an add-on ov: https://images.assettype.com/barandbench/2026-11-11/t4ajnxqx/Ola_CCPA_order.pdf (para 45 'displayed after the consumer has booked the ride at the upfront fare … before any driver has accepted the ride')

https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/olas-extra-pay-for-faster-rides-feature-doesnt-work-ccpa-asks-it-to-scrap-practice-slaps-10-lakh-penalty ('prompting customers to pay extra before a driver accepted their booking')
Prompt wording 'Improve your chances of: https://images.assettype.com/barandbench/2026-11-11/t4ajnxqx/Ola_CCPA_order.pdf (paras 38(iii), 44(vi), 49, 88, 89(i): the app's displayed text as recorded by the CCPA)

https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/olas-extra-pay-for-faster-rides-feature-doesnt-work-ccpa-asks-it-to-scrap-practice-slaps-10-lakh-penalty (reports the prompts as promising a faster ride: 'Adding a tip might help increase the chances of getting a ride faster')
CCPA held the prompts a misleading adver: https://images.assettype.com/barandbench/2026-11-11/t4ajnxqx/Ola_CCPA_order.pdf (para 54 'constitute a misleading advertisement under Section 2(28)'; para 80 'constitutes a dark pattern within the meaning of Clause 2(e)')

https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/olas-extra-pay-for-faster-rides-feature-doesnt-work-ccpa-asks-it-to-scrap-practice-slaps-10-lakh-penalty ('a misleading advertisement, an unfair trade practice, and an unfair contract'; 'confirm shaming … prohibited under the Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023')
Stop the prompts at once on every Ola pl: https://images.assettype.com/barandbench/2026-11-11/t4ajnxqx/Ola_CCPA_order.pdf (para 89(i) 'shall forthwith discontinue … on any platform, application, website or digital interface'; 89(iv) 'compliance report … within 15 days')

https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/olas-extra-pay-for-faster-rides-feature-doesnt-work-ccpa-asks-it-to-scrap-practice-slaps-10-lakh-penalty ('must discontinue the prompts …'; 'submit a compliance report within 15 days')
Ola's own data showed add-on requests we: https://images.assettype.com/barandbench/2026-11-11/t4ajnxqx/Ola_CCPA_order.pdf (para 50 'The opposite party's own data does not substantiate the representation. It contradicts it.')
Suggested amounts started at ₹10–₹40 and: https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/olas-extra-pay-for-faster-rides-feature-doesnt-work-ccpa-asks-it-to-scrap-practice-slaps-10-lakh-penalty ('pre-set amounts ranging from ₹10 to ₹40, which subsequently increased')
Ola argued the add-on is optional, goes: https://images.assettype.com/barandbench/2026-11-11/t4ajnxqx/Ola_CCPA_order.pdf (para 13(iii) 'the entire amount goes to the driver'; para 30(i)(a) 'the add-on feature is optional'; para 51 'commercially less viable' rides, 'does not discharge the burden of substantiation')

https://www.barandbench.com/news/litigation/olas-extra-pay-for-faster-rides-feature-doesnt-work-ccpa-asks-it-to-scrap-practice-slaps-10-lakh-penalty ('voluntary and transferred directly to drivers'; 'commercially unattractive' rides)
Rapido fined ₹10 lakh by the CCPA in Sep: https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/ccpa-fines-rapido-10-lakh-for-alleged-dark-patterns-misleading-fare-prompts-in-ride-bookings ('CCPA Fines Rapido ₹10 Lakh Over Misleading Ads, Dark Patterns And Pre-Ride Payment Prompts')

https://theprint.in/economy/consumer-watchdog-ccpa-slaps-rs-10-lakh-fine-on-rapido/3043486/ ('Rs 10 lakh … Roppen Transportation Services Pvt Ltd … misleading advertisements, unfair trade practices, unfair contract and dark patterns')
National Consumer Helpline: toll-free 19: https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/public/about ('calling the toll free number 1800-11-4000 or 1915'; 'Register your grievance through NCH APP'; 'web portal http://consumerhelpline.gov.in')

https://theprint.in/economy/national-consumer-helpline-upgraded-to-simplify-filing-complaints-before-litigation/2190240/ ('call the toll-free number 1915 or use … the NCH app, the web portal'; 'toll-free number 1800-11-4000 / 14404')
